label: Bible Study
prompt: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the _____ of all thine increase:
verse: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
note: Honour from the top of the harvest, not the leftovers — just a few verses after 'Trust in the LORD.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Cast not away therefore your _____, which hath great recompence of reward.
verse: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
note: Don't toss your confidence overboard — the writer says it comes with a great reward attached.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and _____ bones received strength.
verse: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.
note: The KJV spells it 'ancle' — and the lame man's feet and ancle bones got strong enough to leap.

label: Deep Water
prompt: That if thou shalt _____ with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verse: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
note: Mouth and heart together: Paul's simplest summary of how a person is saved.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a _____ place, and there prayed.
verse: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
note: After a long evening of healing in Capernaum, Jesus rose 'a great while before day' to pray alone.
